text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: added winter_kit setting with people_per_kit: 3 to the HGL (Highlands) region in config/regions.yaml, leaving NVL and CPL unchanged. P2: added winter_kits(household, today=None) to allocation/rations.py — it reads the household's region settings via config.settings.region(), returns 0 when the region has no winter_kit setting (deciding by the setting, not the climate), and otherwise computes people with the same infant-weight rules as food kits (reusing INFANT_AGE, INFANT_WEIGHT, MIN_KITS, ration_size and _today) and returns max(MIN_KITS, math.floor(people / people_per_kit)). P3: added reserve_winter_kits(warehouse_id, qty, household_id) to inventory/stock.py — returns None for qty 0 without reserving, otherwise reserves WINTER-KIT units via the existing reserve_stock with a 72-hour hold and returns the Reservation.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2", "P3"]}}
